description: Electric power outages from 900k simulated hurricanes in a changing climate, for the United States and Puerto Rico Data for: Rice et al. (2025), "Projected Increases in Tropical Cyclone-induced U.S. Electric Power Outage is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Julian R. Rice, Karthik Balaguru (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory). This dataset is described and explored in Rice et al. 2025, "Projected Increases in Tropical Cyclone-induced U.S. Electric Power Outage Risk", published in Environmental Research Letters. Coverage: several countries (US, PR); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
